lines: - Lotus: "Tenno. With Vor gone, Corpus forces have begun to scavenge his camps. Intel suggests they have detected a signal emanating from some reactivated Orokin-era technology. Move in and find the source of that signal before they do."
- Lotus: "Careful. There are Corpus heat signatures ahead. Move towards the source of the signal. I will try and patch you into their comms."
- Treasurer: "Vor's demise is our golden opportunity. Corpus! Bring me the Orokin Mod Segment that our dearest benefactor, Nef Anyo, so deeply desires. Now, enough of this idleness. Go."
- Lotus: "The technology is a Mod Segment? That must stay out of Corpus hands at all costs! Tenno, recover it immediately."
- Lotus: "Neither Grineer or Corpus have the authorization to activate an Orokin-era distress beacon. So who did? Be wary."
- Teshin: "Hmmm... Am I to believe that you are the Tenno who cut down the mighty Vor? Even these covetous merchants avoided triggering the segment's anti-tampering routine."
- Teshin: "The Tenno I remember could find their enemy's weakness faster than the kubrodon finds a jugular. What happened to you?"
- Teshin: "I need to see for myself. Have the Tenno risen or is this another Lotus trick?"
- Lotus: "This Tenno is not your foe."
- Teshin: "Do you even remember the Old War?"
- Teshin: "She made sure all the Tenno forgot. A mercy I suppose.
- Teshin: "Finally. You have rested too long. Get up. Now."
- Teshin: "I have disabled your Warframe's abilities. Orokin tricks won't help you now. Pick up that weapon."
- Teshin: "Your life depends on you proving to me that you are a Tenno and not some imposter. Now, try and cut me down!"
- Teshin: "We are beyond her reach. You are alone."
- Teshin: "What feeble game is the Lotus playing?"
- Teshin: "Yes! A Tenno indeed. How long I have waited for this day. Stand down. We have much to review, and little time to do so."
- Teshin: "Your weapons bear no mods. Your Orbiter - no Mod Segment. Can the Lotus not provide even the simplest- It matters not, I now have one in my Arsenal."
- Teshin: "Your first lesson is simple. Destroy these targets."

- Teshin: "Can you not see? They are outfitted with advanced shields, vulnerable only to Electric elemental attacks. Your body remembers the stances, but your mind has forgotten your studies. Use my Arsenal and upgrade your weapon."

path: After Installing Stormbringer Mod to Thornbak
lines: - Teshin: "See? Mods were the hidden power behind the Orokin's military. Capable of turning simple weapons into implements of mass destruction. Fueled by the miracle of Endo, they can be endlessly rearranged and tailored to cut through the defenses of any foe."
- Teshin: "Next lesson, see how your weapon fares against these targets."
- Teshin: "These shields are only weak to Magnetic elemental damage."
- Teshin: "Remember your Alchemy. When Electricity combines with Cold you create a Magnetic field. Apply your mods accordingly."

path: After Installing Cryo Rounds Mod to Thornbak
lines: - Teshin: "See? So simple, even a child could do it. Now test your work."
- Teshin: "Right on schedule. Show these Corpus all you have learned."
- Treasurer: "Didn't think I would find you? Ha, you underestimate my tenacity and desire!"
- Teshin: "Your Warframe is fragile. How has the Lotus allow you to enter battle in this state?"
- Teshin: "More will come soon. Bolster your Warframe."

path: After Installing Vitality Mod to Warframe
lines: - Teshin: "Much better. That was the scouts, but the cavalry gather. Collect your weapons and take whatever Mods you need. We have little time."
- Teshin: "I will take care of these mercenaries. Take the Mod Segment. It is too valuable to fall into Corpus hands."
- Teshin: "Take the Segment and go. I am not done here."
- Lotus: "Tenno! Tenno? Get to extraction. Is that a Mod Segment?"
- Treasurer: "Oh my, Tenno. I've gone and captured your comrade. So... Let's make a deal. You bring me the Mod Segment. I release the Dax."
- Lotus: "Teshin gave you that Mod Segment? Maybe he can be trusted. Install it at once. You will need maximum power for your next mission."

path: After Installing Mod Segment and Upgrading Stormbringer Mod
lines: - Lotus: "Good. When you are ready, find Teshin."
- Lotus: "Teshin is deep within this ship. Cut through the Corpus and find him."
- Treasurer: "Sweet fortune. What are the odds? Another bird flies into my hands. Nef Anyo will pay dearly for the two of you. Corpus, take the Tenno. Dead or alive, it matters little."
- Lotus: "You found him. First, eliminate the Wardens."
- Lotus: "Get Teshin out of that cell!"
- Teshin: "She sent you to rescue me?"
- Lotus: "Not quite, Teshin. The Tenno is on a capture mission."
- Teshin: "Very well. If you think they are ready."
- Teshin: "You have already learned mod fusion. Did you show them this, Lotus?"
- Teshin: "Yes. You are the Tenno I remember."
- Lotus: "One more order of business, Tenno. Scuttle this vessel."
- Lotus: "The reactor is protected by two control systems, you need to breach both systems to expose the reactor core."
- Lotus: "This is it. Take out the reactor."
- Lotus: "It is done. Now find extraction."
- Treasurer: "No. My ship. By the Tenets, how is this possible???"
- Lotus: "Treasurer, may I make a suggestion? Put out a distress call. When you do, let them all know, the Tenno are back."
- Teshin: "Lotus... What you had the Tenno do to the Orokin? It was necessary. I concede that now. Will you tell them the truth of the matter?"
- Lotus: "In time. There are difficult conversations ahead. They will need a mentor."
- Teshin: "You trust me to do this?"
- Lotus: "If you trust me to be their Lotus?"
- Teshin: "It is not my choice. It is theirs."
> You have learned much in a short period, but your work has barely started.

> I have word from Venus. The people of Fortuna suffer under a corrupt, despotic preacher named Nef Anyo. They require a champion capable of fighting Corpus. Use the Venus Junction to bypass faction blockades.

> When you get to Fortuna, find a gentleman who goes by the moniker, The Business. He is trustworthy. Your Lotus has graciously offered me residence in the relay. Come see me, when you wish to learn more.
(Attachments: Pressure Point, Fury, Serration, Hornet Strike, Heated Charge, Continuity, Equilibrium, Redirection, 500 Endo, 30,000 Credits)
